brief:
The United Nations has called on Israel to do more to prevent and prosecute settler violence, according to Al Jazeera English. The demand comes amid ongoing tensions over unauthorized outposts and attacks on Palestinian communities in the West Bank.

Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu warned of threats from Israel's "enemies" ahead of elections, framing security concerns as a central campaign issue.
dek: Netanyahu warns again of Israel’s ‘enemies’ planning an attack before elections.
title: UN demands Israel take stronger action against settler violence
